items.summary: Update the Service Provider profile experience so that, immediately after a Service Provider logs in and navigates to “My Profile” (Provider Profile page), they first see a read-only summary of their provider information (no editable inputs by default).
Add a clear provider-facing action button labeled “Change Info” on the Provider Profile summary view that switches the page into an edit mode for allowed fields.

In Provider Profile edit mode, add an explicit “Update” (or “Save Changes”) button that becomes enabled only when there are changes and persists the changes to the backend; show clear English success/error feedback.

Enforce that provider bio-data (identity details sourced from an ID document) is not editable in the app by making those fields read-only in both summary and edit experiences, and by enforcing the same restriction server-side so attempts to modify bio-data are ignored or rejected.

Replace/remove the outdated Provider Profile copy that says profile editing will be available in a future update, and ensure the Provider Profile page messaging matches the new summary-first + Change Info + Update flow.
